title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 617  An Act Converting the Buluangan Barangay High School in the City of San Carlos, Province of Negros Occidental, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Don Carlos Ledesma National High School.
title.orig: Batas Pambansa Blg. 617  An Act Converting the Buluangan Barangay High School in the City of San Carlos, Province of Negros Occidental, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Don Carlos Ledesma National High School.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Buluangan Barangay tại Thành phố San Carlos, Tỉnh Negros Occidental thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Don Carlos Ledesma Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Buluangan Barangay ในเมือง San Carlos จังหวัด Negros Occidental เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Don Carlos Ledesma แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Buluangan Barangay di Kota San Carlos, Provinsi Negros Occidental menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Don Carlos Ledesma Nasional

text.en:
The Buluangan Barangay High School in the City of San Carlos, Province of Negros Occidental,
is converted into a national high school to be known as the Don Carlos Ledesma National High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
